text_markup: Unless otherwise noted, the controller of an ability carries out its effects and makes any choices required. If a player is specified to perform all or part of an effect, the specified player carries out that part of the effect and makes any choices required instead.
text_plain: Unless otherwise noted, the controller of an ability carries out its effects and makes any choices required. If a player is specified to perform all or part of an effect, the specified player carries out that part of the effect and makes any choices required instead.

examples.text_markup: {card:Rototurret}'s first subroutine reads, "Trash 1 installed program." Since {card:Rototurret} is a Corp card, the Corp chooses which installed program to trash. Conversely, {card:Bulwark}'s first subroutine reads, "The Runner trashes 1 installed program." Since the Runner is specified to be carrying out this effect, they choose which of their installed programs to trash.
